Dried Hibiscus Flower Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Hibiscus flower powder is made from dried hibiscus flowers, milled into a fine, deep red powder with a tart, fruity taste. Tradenest Naturals supplies dried hibiscus flower powder to tea blenders, beverage brands, food processors and cosmetic companies around the world. We select the flowers carefully and source them from trusted growers. The result is a vivid powder that keeps the natural tartness and crimson colour of the flower. Are you looking for a dependable hibiscus flower powder exporter india? We are an FSSAI registered food business and IEC registered exporter in Surat. Our buyers range from small specialty tea brands to established food manufacturers. We keep processing steps the same for every lot, so the colour and flavour you approve in a sample is what you receive in bulk.

Processing and Quality

Good powder starts with good flowers. We work with experienced growers and suppliers and inspect each lot on arrival. The flowers are cleaned and dehydrated with gentle drying that helps protect the natural pigments, flavour and natural acids. After drying, we mill the petals into a fine, free-flowing powder. Every lot is checked for moisture, colour and appearance before packing. The powder contains no added colours, flavours or fillers. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Our bulk hibiscus flower powder supplier service also includes export documentation support, so your import process stays smooth.

Key Specifications and Applications

Our dried hibiscus flower powder is milled to 80-100 mesh. This fine texture disperses quickly in both hot and cold liquids. Moisture is kept at or below 8%, which helps the powder stay free-flowing in storage. Food and beverage manufacturers use it in herbal teas, iced drinks, jams, sauces and confectionery. Cosmetic brands add it to natural hair care and skincare products. Bakers and dessert makers also use small amounts as a natural colouring ingredient in icings, fillings and fruit syrups. Whether you need ingredients for private label products or larger food production, we can help. We offer OEM and private label packing and a low 5 Kg minimum order. Our pricing is fair and quoted clearly for each order.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for dried hibiscus flower powder?

Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg. This suits growing brands, product development teams and larger industrial buyers alike. Contact us to discuss your volume needs.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack in moisture-resistant, food-grade pouches, HDPE containers and export bulk bags. Stored cool and dry, away from direct sunlight, the shelf life is 24 months.

How do I request a sample or quote?

Send our sales team your quantity and destination port through the website or by email. We reply with pricing and shipping details, and samples are available on request.
